decision.explanation: Multiple distinct flights numbered 63 exist in the provided text: American Airlines Flight 63 (1943) is described with conflicting aircraft types (Douglas DC-3 in d00 vs. Boeing 747-178 in d02), Toa Domestic Airlines Flight 63 (1971) is consistently identified as a NAMC YS-11A-217, and STS-63 is identified as the Space Shuttle Discovery.
